subject: Onsite demo & HQ visit — calendar slots, room & NDA
messages:
From: Sara Khan <sara.khan@avatech.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Nguyen <tom.nguyen@avatech.com>
Date: Fri, 13 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: Onsite demo + HQ tour (Mar 22-24)

Hi Connor,

Thanks again for the product intro last week — the team at Avatech is keen to see Redwood running on our workloads. We'd like to schedule an onsite demo at your HQ the week of Mar 22 if that's possible. Ideal windows for our leadership and infra folks are:

- Mon Mar 22: afternoon (1pm–4pm)
- Tue Mar 23: morning (9am–12pm)
- Wed Mar 24: flexible all day

We'll bring 6 people (technical + procurement). Can you confirm availability, a suggested agenda (runtime + cost breakdown + Q&A), and whether we need to sign an NDA beforehand? Also please let us know whether you can host the session in a conference room with video and an outlet for our equipment.

Appreciate it — Sara

Sara Khan
Head of Infrastructure Programs
Avatech Inc.
ops@avatech.com
+1 (415) 555-0192
From: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Khan <sara.khan@avatech.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 13 Mar 2026 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Onsite demo + HQ tour (Mar 22-24)

Hi Sara — great to hear, we'd love to host Avatech at our SF office. Quick responses inline: 

- Availability: We can do Tue Mar 23 morning (9:30–12:00) or Wed Mar 24 (10:00–2:00). I recommend Tue morning for the tighter agenda, Wed if you want extended hands-on time.
- Agenda (proposed):
  1) 9:30–9:45 — Welcome & introductions
  2) 9:45–10:30 — Live demo: hosted vs. dedicated vs. private deployment patterns
  3) 10:30–11:00 — Performance & cost deep-dive (latency profiles, batching/caching)
  4) 11:00–11:30 — Security/compliance overview & Q&A (SOC2, VPC options)
  5) 11:30–12:00 — Next steps / mutual action plan

- NDA: Yes — for facility access and to share a short internal runbook we ask guests to sign our visitor NDA. I attached the visitor NDA (Redwood_Visitor_NDA_v2.pdf) and our 3rd-floor floorplan so you can see meeting room options. Please sign via DocuSign and we'll countersign.
- Room & AV: Lauren, can you confirm a room with a 12-person capacity + video-conference and whiteboard for Mar 23/24? Marcus will coordinate a travel tour and parking passes.

If Mar 23 morning works, I'll send a calendar invite and reserve the room.

Best,
Connor
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
connor@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0110

Attachments: Redwood_Visitor_NDA_v2.pdf (application/pdf, 162 KB), HQ_Floorplan_3rdFloor.png (image/png, 87 KB)

Connor — noted. I have 3rd-floor Conf A (12 seats) available Tue Mar 23 9:00–12:30 and Wed Mar 24 10:00–15:00. I'll provision a Polycom kit and a spare HDMI adapter. Marcus — can you arrange parking passes for Avatech (6 guests)? Also suggest light breakfast (coffee + pastries) for Tue morning.

I'll tentatively block Conf A for Tue 9:00–12:30 until Connor confirms.

Thanks,
Lauren
